long_biography.plain_text:
Metalloinvest became the industrial centre of Alisher Usmanov's holdings after he assembled iron-ore and steel assets through a series of acquisitions. The Uzbekistan-born investor had first made money manufacturing plastic bags, then worked in finance and investment before building the mining and metallurgical group.

Usmanov subsequently brought metals, telecommunications, technology and media interests together under USM and backed internet companies during their early expansion. Fencing remained a substantial personal commitment after his competitive years: he became a long-serving international administrator and founded programmes supporting the sport. His Art, Science and Sport foundation has funded cultural, educational, scientific and sporting initiatives.
